sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def sig(frame, color):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color and 30 < n['pixels'] < 200:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            r0,c0,r1,c1=min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)
            rows=frame.ascii.split('\n')
            top=''.join(rows[r0][c0:c1+1]); bot=''.join(rows[r1][c0:c1+1])
            out.append((r0,r1,c0,c1, n['pixels'], top.lstrip('b').count(color) if top else 0, top.find(color), bot.find(color), len(bot.rstrip('b'))))
    return out
res = action(['LEFT']*4)
for i,f in enumerate(frame_sequence.all):
    print(i, 'B:', sig(f,'B'), 'c:', sig(f,'c'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
